The '''Almas Wasteland''' was a [[Death/Legends|dead]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] that surrounded the [[Almas Sith fortress]]. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the wasteland began expanding, a rate of about a one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] increase in radius each [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] scholars studied the area and began to speculate on what was responsible for the expansion of the dead zone.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
